'''Downey''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and [[Commando/Legends|commando]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Lieutenant Downey fought and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] alongside [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Scott (Human)|Scott]]. The two of them watched over one of several entrances into [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Downey watched over one of several entrances into [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. Downey was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]], and guarded the entrance into Echo Base alongside another Rebel commando, named [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Scott (Human)|Scott]]. When guarding the base, Downey was equipped with a [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|cold weather headgear]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|gloves]], and [[Alliance Cold Weather Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] infiltrated Echo Base during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], Downey and Scott were killed by Imperial forces.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempRebelSnow.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Lieutenant Downey, including a male and female depiction]]
Downey was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Downey was introduced to the [[Star Wars video games|game]] during [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 11|Chapter 11]] of [[November 20]], [[2008]]. This Chapter introduced the [[:w:c:swg:Battle of Echo Base|Battle of Echo Base heroic encounter]].<ref name="SWG" />

Players of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[:w:c:swg:Faction|faction]] who partook in this heroic encounter were required to infiltrate [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] alongside Imperial [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]]. When players entered the base, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Downey and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Scott could be seen watching over the entrance from an elevated observation post. If players did not kill either Scott or Downey, the snowtrooper NPC's would do so themselves, in the process of taking over the base. Therefore, their [[Death/Legends|deaths]] are considered [[canon]]. In the game, Downey was referred to as Lt. Downey, and examining the NPC revealed Downey to be a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]].<ref name="SWG" />

[[Scott Downey]] was an artist who worked on the Battle of Echo Base heroic encounter for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. However, no relation between him and the characters Scott and Downey has been mentioned.<ref name="News">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67852&month=072008|text=SWG Team Profile – Scott Downey}}</ref>
